description: This Java class 'JsLanguageFileMappingCreator' generates a mapping of locale-specific JavaScript language files for various UI components and creates a Java source file using a FreeMarker template. It is part of the OFBiz framework and facilitates localization of JavaScript UI elements.

classes.name: JsLanguageFileMappingCreator
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating a mapping of locale-specific JavaScript language files and generating a Java source file from a FreeMarker template.

methods.name: createJsLanguageFileMapping
methods.description: Static method that generates locale-specific JavaScript file mappings, renders a FreeMarker template, and writes the output to a Java source file.
